title: String.Pos.Raw.extract: logical model and compiled code disagree
summary: For a one-byte slice at a huge position, the logical definition of String.Pos.Raw.extract returns the empty string while the compiled code returns the whole string. With native_decide the two can be played against each other to prove False, and Trail of Bits used this for a 'proof' of Fermat's Last Theorem. Not a kernel bug: #print axioms shows the native_decide axiom, so only proofs that trust the compiler are affected. A use-after-free in the same function was fixed separately. Affects stable Lean up to 4.33.1.
